items.title: Bill Goodwin interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 28, 2025
items.q: And I had befriended him because of my friendship with — or he befriended me because of my friendship with Art Pepper.

ctx.x: I wasn’t an audiophile but I really knew how records were made. I’d been hanging out in the studio since I was a teenager and hearing these great musicians and I was no stranger to that part of the business as far as being a musician. But the producer was quite often not really very musically inclined in a way. They were businessmen, I mean they got classic guys, you know the Bob Thiele and the Ertugen brothers and so forth, Lester Koenig was a great model for me from Contemporary Records. And I had befriended…
I bet you were soaking it all in.
